title: Cannot save photos sent from iPhone as jpg on our hard drive. Have done this for ten years until yesterday.
creator: EastTenn
content:
As a twelve or more years user of Thunderbird, I find it to be okay most of the time. I hate the spam folder that does not learn and I hate threads.

Today all of a sudden, I cannot save photos sent from my iPhone as jpg. I have always right clicked and a menu has appeared. Today, the right click just zooms in which I never want to do when I am trying to save.

I tried searchig online first before coming here. Apple is claiming that Thunderbird developers made a mistake and that is why the right click is not working. AI had me try a bunch of different techniques none of which worked.

When I do save after much effort, the "photo" in my Animals folder appears as the Thunderbird logo instead of the real item itself. The other weird thing is that my folders also do NOT show up where they should when I am trying to save. The menu doesn't give me all the folders as it always has. Instead it just say All Files which is not adequate.

title: Thunderbird intermittently fails to download certain POP emails that are visible in Mailwasher Pro. Some messages download normally, others disappear from Mailwasher (as expected after a successful POP retrieval) but never appear in Thunderbird.
creator: GraemeLoughton
content: Summary: Thunderbird intermittently fails to download certain POP emails that are visible in Mailwasher Pro. Some messages download normally, others disappear from Mailwasher (as expected after a successful POP retrieval) but never appear in Thunderbird. No error messages are shown. Environment: • Email client: Thunderbird (current version) • Account type: POP3 • Anti spam tool: Mailwasher Pro • OS: Windows 10/11 • Mailwasher behaviour: Messages appear correctly in MW’s inbox list. • Thunderbird behaviour: Using Get Messages retrieves some emails, but others vanish from MW without being written into Thunderbird’s Inbox. Detailed Behaviour: 7. Mailwasher shows new incoming messages normally. 8. When Thunderbird performs a POP “Get Messages”: • Some messages download correctly into Thunderbird’s Inbox and disappear from MW (expected). • Other messages disappear from MW (as if retrieved) but do not appear in Thunderbird. 9. These “evaporated” messages are not: • In Inbox • In Junk • In Trash • In Local Folders • In any filter redirected folder 10. No error dialog appears in Thunderbird. 11. Mailwasher logs show the messages were handed off to the mail client (this by omission). 12. The issue has become more frequent recently. Suspected Areas: • Thunderbird POP retrieval logic intermittently failing to write messages to Inbox. • Possible interaction between MW’s “hand off to mail client” and Thunderbird’s POP session. • Potential profile corruption or POP state file corruption (popstate.dat). • Possible Thunderbird bug affecting selective message retrieval. Assistance Requested: • How to diagnose POP retrieval failures where messages vanish from MW but do not appear in Thunderbird. • Whether Thunderbird logs can show POP level message acceptance or rejection. • Whether popstate.dat or Inbox file corruption could cause selective message loss. • Recommended steps to isolate MW interaction vs Thunderbird internal handling.

title: Option to right click a photo and get a save-as option has disappeared recently
creator: salishaire
content:
Windows 11 home, Thunderbird 156.0 (64 bit)

Recently I noted a changed behavior - emails with photo(s) in them used to have the option to right click on the photo and then an option to save-as was offered. The only thing that happens now with a right click is the photo is enlarged or shrunk - no other options.

I wondered if this was an iphone initiated email only problem but it also occurs when I send a jpg photo from my desktop from one email address to another.

I have tried a number of suggestions from the internet without success and my frustration is mounting.

Thank You Norman
